messages.author: Priya Raman
messages.text: TikTok creative fatigue check: TT-UGC-01 CTR is down ~20% from its first two weeks. Others are holding. Can we get one or two fresh UGC pieces before Q4 stuff lands?

replies.author: Hana Kobayashi
replies.text: Yes, we have unused footage from the June shoot. Lucas can cut two new hooks next week.
